confidence_notes: Holistic USD estimates from general knowledge of Reykjavik price levels for peak July, not converted from a checked ISK rate. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable. Peak-season hotel and hostel rates are least certain and can vary widely with demand. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from the beer anchor (about 1.7x and 1.3x) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation came from search snippets of the RBA table showing 0.6947 for 16 Oct 2026, while snippets of the RBA homepage showed 0.6955 for 15 Oct. Verify on the live RBA page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single close comparable. Based on general Nordic capital price levels (such as Oslo and Copenhagen) for food and drink, with a summer peak-season premium applied to accommodation.
